description: Stop test runs that are still queued or running, by run number or by the batch one launch made. Each stops at its next turn: the conversations it already had stay in the results and are judged, and the run settles as stopped. Use it when the user wants a launch cancelled.

batch.description: Stop every run of one launch that is still working: the batch_id run_tests or run_suite returned.
batch.title: Batch

project.description: The project's number (as the app shows it, e.g. 12 or '#12') or its name. Optional when the organization has one project.
project.title: Project

runs.description: The run numbers to stop, e.g. [24, 25].
runs.title: Runs

name: stop_runs
